question: Who made the world and everything in the world?
options: God
The angels
Man
Nature formed by chance
full_answer: God. "In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth." Genesis 1:1.

question: How did God create all things?
options: With pre-existing materials
Out of nothing, by just giving the command through the words of His mouth
By asking the angels to construct them
Through millions of years of experimentation
full_answer: God made everything out of nothing but by just giving the command, through the words of HIS mouth.

question: How was man's body made?
options: Out of the dust of the ground
From the sea foam
From the sunlight
From animal tissue
full_answer: Man's body was made out of the dust of the ground. "And the Lord formed man of the dust of the ground." Genesis 2:7.

question: How was man's soul given to him?
options: He evolved naturally
God breathed into his nostrils the breath of life
Through eating the tree of life
The angels whispered life into him
full_answer: God breathed into him. "And God breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul." Genesis 2:7.

question: In how many days did the Creation take place?
options: In three days
In seven days
In six days
In twelve days
full_answer: In six days. "And God saw everything that he had made, and behold, it was very good, and the evening and the morning were the sixth day." Genesis 1:31.

question: What word do we use to express the fact that the three persons — the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit — are one God?
options: The Omnipresence
The Trinity
The Sanctuary
The Covenant
full_answer: The Trinity.

question: How do we know what God is like?
options: By scientific experiments
By guessing and philosophy
By reading the Bible and by Jesus' life on earth
By dreams and visions only
full_answer: We know what He is like by reading the Bible and by Jesus' life on earth.

question: Who does God love?
options: Only good church leaders
Only the children of Israel
Everybody in the whole world, for "God is love"
Only those who never sin
full_answer: God loves everybody in the whole world, for "God is love."

question: How should we act toward God?
options: We should honour and love God's name and be reverent in God's house
We should treat Him like an equal friend without reverence
We only need to think about Him on Sundays
We should fear Him with terror and avoid prayer
full_answer: We should honour and love God's name and be reverent in God's house. "Let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear." Hebrews 12:28.

question: What Bible verse expresses God's love for everyone?
options: Romans 3:23
John 3:16
Genesis 1:1
Psalm 23:1
full_answer: John 3:16 "For God so loved the world that He gave His only begotten Son that whosoever believeth in Him should not perish but have everlasting life."

question: How long has God lived?
options: He started when the world began
God has lived always, and will live forever
About 6,000 years
Until the end of human history
full_answer: God has lived always, and will live forever.

question: Is God good?
options: God is holy, just and good
God is indifferent to morality
God changes between good and harsh
God is good only to the righteous
full_answer: God is holy, just and good. "And the Lord passed by before him, and proclaimed-The Lord, The Lord God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth." Exodus 34:6.

question: Does God ever change?
options: Yes, He changes with different eras
God is always the same. "For I am the Lord, I change not"
He changes His mind often
He changes depending on how people treat Him
full_answer: God is always the same. "For I am the Lord, I change not." Malachi 3:6.

question: Is there more than one God?
options: Yes, there are many gods for each nation
There is but one living and true God
There are three different gods in Heaven
There were once many gods, now only one
full_answer: There is but one living and true God. "...the Lord is God, and that there is none else." 1 Kings 8:60.

question: Can we see God?
options: Yes, with special telescopes
God is a spirit and cannot be seen. "No man hath seen God at any time"
Yes, in the form of clouds
Any pure person can see Him face to face now
full_answer: God is a spirit and cannot be seen. "No man hath seen God at any time." John 1:18.

question: What have we learned about the personality of God?
options: God is an impersonal force of nature
God is a spirit, infinite, eternal and unchangeable in His being, wise, powerful, holy, just, good and true
God is a human who became divine
God is a distant observer who does not intervene
full_answer: God is a spirit, infinite, eternal and unchangeable in His being, wise, powerful, holy, just, good and true.

question: What person is introduced in the first verse of the Bible?
options: Adam
Moses
God, our Heavenly Father
Abraham
full_answer: God, our Heavenly Father.

question: Who is God?
options: The Creator and Ruler of all things
An ancient king of Israel
An angel with great power
A figure of ancient mythology
full_answer: God is the Creator and Ruler of all things.

question: What does God know?
options: Only things that happen in the day
God knows all things even our thoughts
Only things written in books
Everything except the future
full_answer: God knows all things even our thoughts. "Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off." Psalms 139:2.

question: What can God do?
options: Only what human laws permit
God can do whatever He chooses to do. He can do all things
He can only control the weather
He can do everything except defeat evil
full_answer: God can do whatever He chooses to do. He can do all things. "Behold, I am the Lord, the God of all flesh: is there anything too hard for me?" Jeremiah 32:27.

question: What separated Adam and Eve from God?
options: A wide river
Their disobedience
The angel of death
Old age
full_answer: Their disobedience.

question: What can people do so they will not be separated from God?
options: Confess their sins and ask God to forgive them for their disobedience
Offer animal sacrifices in the temple
Hide their mistakes and never speak of them
Do lots of charity without repentance
full_answer: Confess their sins and ask God to forgive them for their disobedience.

question: Who tempted Adam and Eve to disobey God?
options: An Egyptian priest
Satan, the Devil
The angel Gabriel
Cain
full_answer: Satan, the Devil.

question: Has anyone else besides Adam and Eve disobeyed God?
options: No, only Adam and Eve sinned
Yes, everyone, the whole human race. "For all have sinned and come short of the glory of God"
Only people who went to prison
Only adults, not young people
full_answer: Yes, everyone, the whole human race. "For all have sinned (disobeyed) and come short of the glory of God." Romans 3:23.

question: How did God create all things? (Repeated review in catechism)
options: God made everything out of nothing but by just giving the command, through the words of HIS mouth
By assembling elements over centuries
Through physical labor like a builder
By taking material from another universe
full_answer: God made everything out of nothing but by just giving the command, through the words of HIS mouth.

question: Is there any reason why we should evangelize?
options: Only if we want to earn extra points
Yes, because Jesus told us to do so ("And ye shall be witnesses unto me...")
Only pastors are allowed to evangelize
No, everyone will naturally find out on their own
full_answer: Yes, because Jesus told us to do so. "And ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem and in all Judea, and in Samaria and unto the uttermost part of the earth." Acts 1:8.

question: What is one of the best ways to evangelize?
options: Argue with people until they agree
Talk to people about Jesus Christ and show them how they can belong to God's family
Give them money to come to church
Wait quietly and never speak
full_answer: One of the best ways is to talk to people about Jesus Christ and show them how they can belong to God's family.

question: What is personal soul winning?
options: Winning a Bible quiz trophy
To tell a person about Jesus Christ and to show him how to become a Christian
Writing a book about theology
Donating clothes to the poor
full_answer: Personal soul winning is to tell a person about Jesus Christ and to show him how to become a Christian.

question: How do you lead someone to Jesus Christ?
options: By forcing them to attend services every week
By showing him in the Bible that Jesus loves him, why he needs Jesus as personal Saviour, and telling him he must accept Christ as Saviour
By teaching him church history
By asking him to do good deeds first
full_answer: You lead a person to Christ by showing him in the Bible that Jesus loves him and show him why he needs Jesus as personal Saviour, and by telling him he must accept Christ as Saviour.

question: What will show the non-Christian person that he needs Jesus Christ as his own Saviour?
options: Human philosophy
The Bible which is God's Word
Science textbooks
Social media posts
full_answer: The Bible which is God's Word. "And that from a child thou hast known the holy Scriptures. Which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus." II Timothy 3:15.

question: Can anyone help someone else to become a Christian?
options: No, only ordained bishops and reverends
Yes, everyone who first has accepted Christ as his own Saviour and lives for Him each day can help others to become Christians
Only elderly Christians
Only those who have attended Bible college
full_answer: Yes, everyone who first has accepted Christ as his own Saviour and lives for Him each day can help others to become Christians.

question: Is it the responsibility of every Christian to tell other people about Jesus Christ?
options: No, only professional evangelists
Yes, every Christian is responsible to see that people around the world hear the story of Jesus Christ and what He has done for us
Only Sunday school teachers
Only when asked direct questions
full_answer: Yes, every Christian is responsible to see that people around the world hear the story of Jesus Christ and what He has done for us.

question: Where may we tell others about Jesus?
options: Everywhere: home, school, play, work, church or any place we meet non-Christian people
Only inside a dedicated church building
Only on Sunday mornings
Only in foreign mission fields
full_answer: Everywhere: home, school, play, work, church or any place we meet non-Christian people.

question: What does Proverbs 11:30 say about people who win people to Christ?
options: "...he that winneth souls is rich"
"...he that winneth souls is wise"
"...he that winneth souls shall never weep"
"...he that winneth souls is famous"
full_answer: Proverbs 11:30b "...he that winneth souls is wise."

question: How did God make it possible for us to have eternal life?
options: By building great monuments
By sending angels to teach us philosophy
God gave His only begotten Son that whosoever believeth in Him should not perish but have everlasting life
By requiring impossible rituals
full_answer: "For God so loved the world, that He gave His only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in Him, should not perish but have everlasting life." John 3:16.

question: What did God do with the sins of the people?
options: He pretended they did not exist
He permitted Jesus to take the punishment for the people's sins
He blamed innocent animals forever
He left everyone to bear their own eternal penalty
full_answer: He permitted Jesus to take the punishment for the people's sins. "All we like sheep have gone astray: we have turned everyone to his own way, and the Lord hath laid on him the iniquity (sin) of us all." Isaiah 53:6.

question: What did Jesus do to take away our sins?
options: He died on the cross and there He was punished for our sins
He wrote a book of new laws
He told us to pay money to the temple
He withdrew to the mountains away from mankind
full_answer: He died on the cross and there He was punished for our sins. "...while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us." Romans 5:8.

question: Why have not all people taken Jesus Christ as their Saviour?
options: Because some have never heard about Him and others have not believed on Him
Because Jesus only died for a small group of people
Because the gospel was hidden in a secret vault
Because God does not allow everyone to be saved
full_answer: Because some have never heard about Him and others have not believed on Him. "How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? And how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? And how shall they hear without a preacher?" Romans 10:14.

question: What does salvation mean?
options: Becoming wealthy and respected on earth
To be saved from guilt and the punishment of sin by taking Jesus Christ as Saviour
Having a high score in a religious exam
Joining a social club at church
full_answer: Salvation means to be saved from guilt and the punishment of sin by taking Jesus Christ as Saviour.

question: Do we become a Christian by the good things we do?
options: Yes, if our good deeds outnumber our bad deeds
No, we cannot become saved by doing good things ("For by grace are ye saved through faith... it is the gift of God")
Yes, by being polite and doing charity
Yes, good works are the only requirement for heaven
full_answer: No. we cannot become saved by doing good things. "For by grace are ye saved through faith, and that not of yourselves it is the gift of God: Not of works, lest any man should boast." Ephesians 2:8-9.

question: Can we earn our way to heaven?
options: Yes, with enough hard work and tithes
No, eternal life is a gift given by God ("the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord")
Yes, if our ancestors were saints
Yes, by fasting every day
full_answer: No, eternal life is a gift given by God. "For the wages of sin is death (separation from God) but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord." Romans 6:23.

question: Who conducts the baptismal service?
options: Any church member without permission
The pastor, an evangelist, or any minister of the Gospel
The town mayor
Only angels in heaven
full_answer: The pastor, an evangelist, or any minister of the Gospel.

question: What does the word "communion" mean?
options: A public debate in church
A sacrament where you partake of bread and the juice
Singing in the choir together
Collecting offerings on the first Sunday
full_answer: It is a sacrament where you partake of bread and the juice.

question: What does the bread, served at communion, represent?
options: The physical food eaten in the wilderness
Christ's body which was broken for us when He died on the cross
The grain harvested by the farmers
The unity of the political community
full_answer: The bread represents Christ's body which was broken for us when He died on the cross.

question: What is another name for communion?
options: The Passover Feast
"The Lord's Supper"
The Pentecost Feast
The Love Offering
full_answer: Communion is also known as "The Lord's Supper".

question: What is the full name of our church denomination?
options: The International Church of the Foursquare Gospel
The Evangelical Church of Victory
The Pentecostal Mission International
The United Church of Christ
full_answer: The International Church of the Foursquare Gospel.

question: Who was the human founder of the International Church of the Foursquare Gospel?
options: Aimee Semple McPherson
John Wesley
Charles Spurgeon
Billy Graham
full_answer: Sister Aimee Semple McPherson under the inspiration of the Holy Spirit.

question: What are the four pillars of the Foursquare Gospel?
options: Jesus the Savior, Baptizer with the Holy Spirit, Healer, and Soon-Coming King
Faith, Hope, Charity, and Wisdom
Repentance, Fasting, Tithing, and Prayer
Righteousness, Peace, Joy, and Longsuffering
full_answer: Jesus Christ as our Savior, Baptizer with the Holy Spirit, Healer, and Soon-Coming King.

question: Which symbol represents Jesus as the Savior in the Foursquare emblem?
options: The Cross
The Dove
The Cup
The Crown
full_answer: The Cross represents Jesus Christ as our Savior (John 3:16).

question: Which symbol represents Jesus as the Baptizer with the Holy Spirit in the Foursquare emblem?
options: The Dove
The Cross
The Cup
The Crown
full_answer: The Dove represents Jesus as the Baptizer with the Holy Spirit.

question: Which symbol represents Jesus as the Great Physician and Healer in the Foursquare emblem?
options: The Cup
The Dove
The Cross
The Crown
full_answer: The Cup represents Jesus Christ as the Great Physician and Healer.

question: Which symbol represents Jesus as the Soon-Coming King in the Foursquare emblem?
options: The Crown
The Cup
The Dove
The Cross
full_answer: The Crown represents Jesus Christ as our Soon-Coming King.

question: What colors represent the four symbols of the Foursquare Gospel in order?
options: Red (Cross), Gold (Dove), Blue (Cup), Purple (Crown)
White, Green, Yellow, Black
Blue, Red, White, Purple
Gold, Silver, Bronze, Iron
full_answer: Red represents the Cross, Gold represents the Dove, Blue represents the Cup, and Purple represents the Crown.

question: What is the key scripture theme of the Foursquare Gospel?
options: Hebrews 13:8 - 'Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever'
John 11:35 - 'Jesus wept'
Genesis 1:1 - 'In the beginning God created'
Romans 8:31 - 'If God be for us, who can be against us?'
full_answer: Hebrews 13:8: "Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever."

question: How many books are there in the Holy Bible?
options: 66 books
70 books
60 books
39 books
full_answer: There are 66 books in the Holy Bible (39 in the Old Testament and 27 in the New Testament).

question: How many books are in the Old Testament?
options: 39 books
27 books
66 books
40 books
full_answer: There are 39 books in the Old Testament.

question: How many books are in the New Testament?
options: 27 books
39 books
30 books
24 books
full_answer: There are 27 books in the New Testament.

question: What is the first book of the Bible?
options: Genesis
Exodus
Matthew
Psalms
full_answer: Genesis is the first book of the Bible.

question: What is the last book of the Bible?
options: Revelation
Malachi
Jude
Hebrews
full_answer: The Revelation of Saint John is the last book of the Bible.

question: Who was the human instrument through whom God gave the Ten Commandments?
options: Moses
Abraham
David
Joshua
full_answer: Moses on Mount Sinai.

question: What is the First Commandment?
options: "Thou shalt have no other gods before me"
"Thou shalt not steal"
"Remember the sabbath day"
"Honour thy father and thy mother"
full_answer: "Thou shalt have no other gods before me." Exodus 20:3.

question: Which commandment has a promise of long life attached to it?
options: The Fifth Commandment: "Honour thy father and thy mother"
The Third Commandment: "Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain"
The Eighth Commandment: "Thou shalt not steal"
The Tenth Commandment: "Thou shalt not covet"
full_answer: "Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee." Exodus 20:12.

question: How did Jesus summarize the whole Law and the Prophets?
options: Love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, and mind, and love your neighbor as yourself
Attend temple worship every morning and evening
Memorize all the genealogies of Israel
Offer sacrifices three times a year
full_answer: Love the Lord your God with all your heart, and love your neighbour as yourself.

question: What prayer did Jesus teach His disciples when they asked Him how to pray?
options: The Lord's Prayer ("Our Father who art in heaven...")
The Prayer of Jabez
The Aaronic Blessing
The Prayer of Solomon
full_answer: The Lord's Prayer (Matthew 6:9-13).

question: How many fruits of the Spirit are listed in Galatians 5:22-23?
options: Nine
Seven
Twelve
Ten
full_answer: Nine fruits of the Spirit: Love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, meekness, temperance.

question: Which of the following is the first fruit of the Spirit listed in Galatians 5?
options: Love
Joy
Peace
Faith
full_answer: "The fruit of the Spirit is love..." Galatians 5:22.

question: What is the initial physical evidence of the baptism in the Holy Spirit?
options: Speaking with other tongues as the Spirit gives utterance
Shaking violently
Receiving money
Seeing a bright light
full_answer: Speaking with other tongues as the Spirit gives them utterance.

question: What piece of the Armor of God is used to extinguish all the fiery darts of the wicked one?
options: The Shield of Faith
The Helmet of Salvation
The Belt of Truth
The Shoes of Peace
full_answer: The Shield of Faith (Ephesians 6:16).

question: What is the Sword of the Spirit according to Ephesians 6:17?
options: The Word of God
Human wisdom
Church traditions
Personal feelings
full_answer: The Word of God (Ephesians 6:17).

question: What is water baptism a symbol of?
options: Being buried with Christ in death and raised with Him to walk in newness of life
Washing off physical dirt from the body
Joining a social club
Earning entrance into heaven
full_answer: It signifies that we are buried with Christ in His death and raised to walk in newness of life.

question: In whose name did Jesus command us to baptize believers?
options: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost
In the name of the local church pastor
In the name of the angels
In the name of Abraham and Moses
full_answer: "Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost." Matthew 28:19.

question: What does the cup or juice in Holy Communion represent?
options: Christ's blood which was shed for the remission of our sins
The wine made in Cana of Galilee
The harvest of grapes in Israel
A traditional secular drink
full_answer: The cup represents the New Testament in Christ's blood shed for the remission of sins.

question: What is tithe according to the Bible?
options: One-tenth (10%) of all our increase or earnings given to God's house
Any small coin left in our pocket
A tax paid to the government
An optional donation only when we feel like it
full_answer: The tithe is one-tenth of our income or increase, which belongs holy to the Lord.

question: What blessing does God promise in Malachi 3:10 to those who bring all the tithes into the storehouse?
options: He will open the windows of heaven and pour out a blessing that there shall not be room enough to receive it
He will give them physical wings to fly
They will never have to work again
They will become kings of nations
full_answer: "Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse... and prove me now herewith, saith the Lord of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing..." Malachi 3:10.

question: What does 2 Corinthians 9:7 say about how God wants us to give?
options: "God loveth a cheerful giver"
God only accepts gifts given grudgingly
Give only when forced by others
Give nothing unless you are rich
full_answer: "Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver." 2 Corinthians 9:7.

question: What is the Great Commission given by Jesus in Mark 16:15?
options: "Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature"
"Stay inside your home and do not speak to strangers"
"Build the largest temple in Jerusalem"
"Collect taxes for the Roman empire"
full_answer: "And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature." Mark 16:15.

question: What does Romans 1:16 say about the Gospel of Christ?
options: "For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth"
The gospel is a foolish philosophy of men
The gospel is only for the priests
The gospel is a secret for few people
full_answer: "For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth." Romans 1:16.

question: What must a person do to be saved according to Romans 10:9?
options: Confess with your mouth the Lord Jesus, and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead
Pay a large sum of money to the church
Be born into a royal family
Fast for 40 days without water
full_answer: "That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved." Romans 10:9.

question: What does 2 Corinthians 5:17 say about anyone who is in Christ?
options: "He is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new"
He will never face any trials or tests
He is exactly the same as before
He becomes an angel immediately
full_answer: "Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new." 2 Corinthians 5:17.

question: What is divine healing?
options: The supernatural power of God that heals physical sickness through faith in Jesus Christ
Relying only on magical potions
A myth that stopped after the disciples died
Healing that is bought with money
full_answer: Divine healing is the supernatural power of God touching and healing the sick body through faith in Jesus Christ.

question: What did Isaiah 53:5 prophesy concerning the stripes of Jesus?
options: "...and with his stripes we are healed"
His stripes were in vain
His stripes were only for the angels
His stripes brought poverty
full_answer: "But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed." Isaiah 53:5.

question: What instruction does James 5:14 give if any person is sick among us?
options: Let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord
Hide the person away and do not pray
Blame the person for having sickness
Wait until the sickness gets worse before praying
full_answer: "Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord." James 5:14.

question: What is the Second Coming of Jesus Christ?
options: The personal, visible, glorious return of Jesus Christ to catch up His saints and establish His reign
A symbolic idea that only happens in our minds
An event that happened two thousand years ago
The birth of a new human prophet
full_answer: The personal, visible return of Jesus Christ in power and great glory.

question: What will happen to believers who have died in Christ when the Lord returns?
options: The dead in Christ shall rise first
They will remain forgotten in the dust
They will be reincarnated into animals
They will rise last after all nations
full_answer: "For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout... and the dead in Christ shall rise first." 1 Thessalonians 4:16.

question: Does anyone on earth know the exact day or hour when Jesus will return?
options: No man knows, neither the angels of heaven, but the Father only
Yes, modern astrologers know the date
Yes, church historians calculated it
Every prophet knows the exact day
full_answer: "But of that day and hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only." Matthew 24:36.

question: What is the Golden Rule taught by Jesus in Matthew 7:12?
options: "Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them"
Do unto others before they do unto you
Love only those who show you kindness
He who has the most gold makes the rules
full_answer: "Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets." Matthew 7:12.

question: What does Psalm 119:105 say about God's Word?
options: "Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path"
Thy word is a mystery hidden forever
Thy word is only for old people
Thy word changes every generation
full_answer: "Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path." Psalms 119:105.

question: What does Proverbs 3:5-6 instruct us to do?
options: "Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding"
Trust in your own wealth and education above all
Do whatever feels right in your own eyes
Listen only to the opinions of the crowd
full_answer: "Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths." Proverbs 3:5-6.

question: What does Philippians 4:13 boldly declare for every believer?
options: "I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me"
I cannot do anything because I am weak
I can only do things if others help me
Strength comes from wealth and status
full_answer: "I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me." Philippians 4:13.

question: What does Romans 8:28 promise to those who love God?
options: "All things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose"
Nothing good will ever happen in trials
Only pleasant things happen to Christians
God forgets those who are tested
full_answer: "And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose." Romans 8:28.

question: What does Joshua 1:8 say we must do with the Book of the Law to make our way prosperous?
options: "Meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein"
Keep it closed on the shelf
Read it only once a year on your birthday
Argue about it without obeying it
full_answer: "This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night... for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success." Joshua 1:8.

question: What is faith according to Hebrews 11:1?
options: "The substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen"
Believing only what you can touch with your hands
Hoping for something without any promise from God
A feeling of excitement during music
full_answer: "Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen." Hebrews 11:1.

question: According to Hebrews 11:6, is it possible to please God without faith?
options: No, "without faith it is impossible to please him"
Yes, good manners alone please God

question: What did Jesus say about little children in Matthew 19:14?

Children should be seen and not heard in church

question: What is the true Standard of Attainment for every Christian child and believer?
